criteria.title: Приёмка в браузере на стенде
criteria.how: of the steps 1, 2, 4, 5 given to RELEASE-VALIDATOR: 1, 4 and 5 repeated, step 2 not; the stand had 11 roles, not 19. Stand: an own Pixel Office server started with `node src/pixel-office/main.js --port 0 --dir <outside the project>/stand-…` and SAI_PIXEL_OFFICE_DIR set to the same folder; events written only through the real `src/pixel-office/hook.sh` (26 events: main session sample-1 with an owner request, 10 role runs, B launched by A, two ends, Stop) and one orchestrator record through `src/pixel-office/note.js`; the owner journal, its copies and the ports 4780, 4782, 4790 were not used. Browser: Google Chrome headless, a new profile per page, driven over the debugging protocol with real mouse and key events; Chrome and the stand were stopped by their process ids. Results: <outside the project>/uat/res/po1…po5.json, shots in <outside the project>/uat/res/shots/. Canvas texts were read by wrapping fillText in the page. The other steps by the records: docs/uat/REQ-048-RUN.md, docs/uat/REQ-046-047-048-049-RUN.md, BA-ANALYST PASS.
criteria.evidence: Step 1 (1470×784): the canvas labels are the plain names, «Проверка безопасности» on two lines («Проверка», «безопасности»), «Проверка исследования и» + «плана»; no «…»; the legend holds the same 11 names, no code. Step 4: the SIMULATION row — «не подтверждена», no word SIMULATION in the row; expansion «Источник: не Claude Code», «не подтверждена: строку записал не Claude Code», SIMULATION only in the closed «Технические поля». Step 5: card of «Проверка безопасности» on a stand where the role has two runs — «номер запуска sample-a · номер разговора sample-1», «Все запуски этой роли», no «экземпляр», «хук», «переднего плана», «порог свежести»; «Полные номера и код роли» — «код роли: Sai Security Reviewer (SECURITY-REVIEWER)»; the history window — «оркестратор не указал запрос — запись отнесена к последнему запросу владельца», the column «Агент» holds plain names. Not repeated: step 2 (labels of A and B when B stands at the desk of A, «Пауза») — covered only by LW-03 and by the UAT record.
